name: Oscar Valdes
headline: Cloud engineering. Grounded in operations.
intro: I’m Oscar Valdes. I bring enterprise application support, AWS architecture, and engineering leadership to practical automation and dependable platforms.
about: My background spans enterprise application support, AWS architecture, and engineering leadership. At Kalypso, I progressed from application support to leading Managed Services, supporting enterprise clients and building cloud hosting and deployment capabilities. My independent work now focuses on Kubernetes operations and practical Python automation.
